Welcome to Furever Home Animal Rescue! www.fureverhome-rescue.org

We’re on a mission to save the underdogs — literally. Based in DC, Maryland & Virginia, we rescue dogs in crisis (with a soft spot for pitties facing breed discrimination) and help them find the loving homes they deserve.

💔 From high-risk shelters → 💕 to forever homes
🐕‍🦺 Fighting breed stereotypes
📣 Spreading the word on responsible pet parent life

Whether you’re here to adopt, foster, or watch some adorable dog videos — you're part of the pack. Let’s build a world where every dog gets their fair shot. #AdoptDontShop #PittiePower #fureverfamily 

If you are a DC, Maryland, or Virginia resident, check out our adoptable dogs here: https://www.fureverhome-rescue.org/
